Her anatomical LEFT arm cradles the small fluffy white fox with purple eyes and lavender ear interiors against her left ribs; her anatomical RIGHT palm carries the small hovering blue snowflake crystal. Preserve the portrait's head/body proportion about 2.3 heads tall, no adult proportions.
Camera and facing: rear-right three-quarter view, facing and moving toward screen top-right. Fixed mild elevated orthographic RPG camera, not perspective camera, no camera tilt. Head, chest, pelvis and planted foot direction agree. Do not turn head toward viewer in rear views.
Action: Exactly frame 02 of a 16-frame cyclic natural WALK, phase 22.5 degrees. Anatomical LEFT and RIGHT are the character's own limbs. LEFT foot rolls down from heel, LEFT knee starts flexing to accept weight; RIGHT heel rises behind, toe still touches ground.

Both legs must remain anatomically separate; never invent extra limbs, reverse knees, or show the undersides of both boots. Keep torso and head scale stable, with only tiny natural vertical weight shift.

Bright clean soft hand-painted shading with readable white fur and lilac fabric, no glare, no color fringe.
Render a new independently drawn exact pose; do not duplicate, mirror, warp or translate the reference to simulate motion. Highest available visual finish. Deliver the transparent image only.
Targeted correction: Keep Image 3 exact REAR-RIGHT camera and stable UPPER BODY. We see back of head, only tiny right cheek edge, no eye looking at camera. Head does not turn. Same back purple sash knot, no front fox buckle, no tail. Fox is carried LEFT far side, snowflake is on RIGHT near palm. Shoes face top-right showing heel backs, never front laces. Legs move only in the same top-right direction along separate parallel tracks. The LEFT far leg on SCREEN-LEFT is ahead along its own track (slightly UP-RIGHT); its foot rolls flat on ground taking weight. The RIGHT near leg on SCREEN-RIGHT trails slightly DOWN-LEFT along its own parallel track, heel rising while toe remains grounded.

from pathlib import Path
import json,sys,subprocess
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0,str(R/'14-tools'))
from prepare import PHASES
d,f,version=sys.argv[1:4]; n=int(f)
anchor=R/'14-generation'/f'{d}01-v2/raw.png'
subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(R/'14-tools/prepare.py'),d,f,'--version',version,'--anchor',str(anchor)],check=True,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL)
qdir=R/'14-generation'/f'{d}{n:02d}-{version}'; q=json.loads((qdir/'request.json').read_text())
extra=sys.argv[4] if len(sys.argv)>4 else ''
if not extra:
 if d=='SE':
  extra='RIGHT NEAR leg starts at screen-LEFT hip and always stays on SCREEN-LEFT track. LEFT FAR leg starts at screen-RIGHT hip and stays on SCREEN-RIGHT track. '
  if n<=8: extra+='LEFT FAR boot on SCREEN-RIGHT supports weight on ground; RIGHT NEAR boot on SCREEN-LEFT performs the described swing. '
  else: extra+='RIGHT NEAR boot on SCREEN-LEFT supports weight on ground; LEFT FAR boot on SCREEN-RIGHT performs the described swing. '
 else:
  extra='In right-facing profile forward is SCREEN-RIGHT, backward is SCREEN-LEFT. RIGHT leg is NEAR camera and must overlap far leg where they pass. '
  if n<=8: extra+='LEFT FAR leg carries body weight on ground, RIGHT NEAR leg swings in FOREGROUND. '
  else: extra+='RIGHT NEAR leg carries body weight on ground, LEFT FAR leg swings BEHIND it. '
 extra+='Follow the exact heel/toe lift and knee bend for this phase; make it distinct from the stride in target image 3. Keep skirt, fox and palm locations stable, without new wind-blown cloth.'
view='strict RIGHT-facing one-eye profile' if d=='E' else 'front-right view, nose and all toes aiming lower-right'
prompt=f'''Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: ONE single native >=1024x1024 transparent RGBA game WALK frame.
Image 1 is the immutable original identity and costume. Image 2 is approved bright clean rounded Daoist chibi hand-painted rendering style, do not copy any UI. Image 3 is the EDIT TARGET and exact camera/framing/upper-body anchor.
Edit Image 3 into independently drawn walk frame {n:02d}/16. KEEP THE ENTIRE UPPER BODY from ears through sash and fox buckle identical in size, angle, expression, fox position, snowflake position, side assignment and costume; only newly draw the two LEGS with the precise gait below and subtly adjust lower skirt hem as needed. Do not enlarge, translate or mirror the sprite. No identity redesign or arm swing. Camera remains {view}. The viewer sees her anatomical RIGHT side nearer and anatomical LEFT side farther. The LEFT hair ornament stays on the far temple; LEFT arm carries fox on far side; RIGHT near palm carries snowflake.
POSE: {PHASES[n-1]}
RIGHT leg is the NEAR leg. LEFT leg is the FAR leg. Both feet stay on separate parallel tracks; do not cross the knees. Keep exactly TWO short legs and two matching white fur boots. One supporting foot always touches ground, no jumping. Natural compact walking, no running. Grounded sole stays near y=942 at 1024 scale. Head position, body scale and camera remain unchanged. {extra}
Keep the original silver-white short bob, purple eyes, white furry ears, pale lilac embroidered fur robes and short white boots. No new objects or missing accessories. Whole sprite with clean margins. Absolutely transparent alpha background, no white/black background, floor, cast shadow, grid, sheet, labels or text. One frame only. New genuine leg articulation, not duplication or interpolated pose. Highest available hand-painted finish.'''
q['actual_request']['prompt']=prompt; q['intent']='edit target image 3, independently articulate legs; preserve upper body'
(qdir/'prompt.txt').write_text(prompt,encoding='utf-8');(qdir/'request.json').write_text(json.dumps(q,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'archive':str(qdir),'request':q['actual_request']}))

# 14 W / NW selected frames

2026-09-23 completion of the two assigned directions: 32 independently generated walk frames and 2 independent idle frames exported to `../14-delivery-preview/assets`. Each selected source is native 1254×1254 RGBA and each export is 1024×1024 RGBA. Exact slot selection is in `selection.json`; current SHA and source binding checks are in `delivery-audit.json`.

W selected: 01–05 v1; 06–08 v2; 09 v5; 10–16 v1; idle v2. NW selected: 01–04 v1; 05–06 v2; 07–08 v1; 09 v2; 10 v1; 11–13 v2; 14–16 v1; idle v2.

All additions used the built-in tool, one call per complete frame. No paid API, mirroring, pose warping, copying a frame to another slot, or interpolation was used. Every real output has its raw, exact request/prompt, actual output_hint and generation metadata. Actual model and quality remain null / host managed and unverified. Older prepared request NW13-v1 has no tool-result or raw and was not submitted in this continuation.

Static visual review inspected every selected full figure on both dark and light backgrounds, plus enlarged 15→16→01→02 seam strips. W maintains the left-facing profile with carried fox on anatomical left and crystal on anatomical right; NW maintains the rear-left view and back sash bow. Each direction has alternate supporting legs, recovery and passing poses; idle v2 has both boots close and planted. No clipped ears, missing carried fox, duplicate limbs, painted background or front buckle on the rear sash was accepted.

Rejected/superseded sources: W09 v1–v4 did not reliably reverse the leading leg; v5 provides clearer near trailing thigh in front of the far leading thigh. W06–08 v1 were replaced to follow that corrected half-cycle. NW05 v1 and NW06 v1 showed the lifted boot as a backward kick rather than forward passing; v2 corrected them. NW09 v1 retained the first-half leg order; v2 reverses the forward/back feet. NW11/12 v1 lifted the wrong screen-side foot; v2 changes to right support and left recovery. Idle v1 sources retain staggered stepping, replaced with v2.

Remaining review is real: small frame-to-frame head/robe/pendant differences remain in independent drawings, and fine blue/magenta fringes are visible at native scale. Root owns the authorized RGB-only fringe cleanup and final eight-direction 30 ms loop verification. The reviewed seam strips have consistent next-step direction, but this document does not claim browser-loop or Unity/client validation. The export anchor is the lowest alpha pixel at y942, not measured world-space ground contact in the rear perspective.

No original image, rejected output or rollback image was deleted in this continuation. Parent relayed a newer instruction to retain real raw and requests while final review proceeds.

# 14 S / SW 生成工作记录

本子代理只生成 S / SW 的真实单帧，所有原图均保留于宿主生成目录并复制到 `14-generation`。使用内置 image_gen，工具未披露型号/质量；实际值未确认，配置目标与真实参数分开记录。每稿保存 prompt.txt、request.json、tool-result.json、raw.png。未调用付费 API。

## S 方向：16 walk + 1 idle 候选

建议预览选用：Sidle-v2；S01-v1、S02-v1、S03-v2、S04-v2、S05-v1、S06-v2、S07-v1、S08-v1、S09-v1、S10-v1、S11-v1、S12-v1、S13-v1、S14-v1、S15-v2、S16-v1。

所有 S 帧仍有共同蓝紫边/白色晕边疑点；精细袍纹、雪花粒子及头部角度有小变化。这里只确认独立生成和单帧初筛，**尚未完成固定缩放导出、深浅底/正常放大、30ms连播或接缝验收**，不能据此标美术通过。

## SW 方向

# 14 唤雪少女：当前制作记录

仅负责 `14_short_hair_snow_summoner_girl`。状态：制作与离线验收进行中，不能据此标记已通过。未修改其他角色，未做 Git 提交、推送或清理，未接入 Unity/正式客户端。

## 来源与导出

使用内置 image_gen，每调用为一个完整原生单帧，已查选稿均为 1254×1254 RGBA，导出 1024×1024 RGBA。配置目标与实际参数分开：实际 model/quality 未披露，记录 null / host-managed-unverified；收费 API 为零。身份参考为原肖像的 1024 传输副本，风格实际附 `designs/jubaozhai-ui/02-characters.png`。姿态修订同时附成功的方向和腿阶段参考，原始请求保持真实。

`14-generation/<方向帧号>-vN/` 中暂存 raw.png、prompt.txt、request.json、tool-result.json、raw.png.generation.json；最终 PNG 同名 `.generation.json` 含原生尺寸、原图 SHA、导出参数、精确请求和实际回执。`14-tools/verify_sources.py` 可核对选稿和 SHA，但视觉验收是独立步骤。尚未生成回执的准备请求不可当成已出图。

用户已授权仅清理蓝紫残边：只改轮廓附近 RGB，不改 alpha、尺寸、姿势、服饰。当前 135 张曾批量处理，之后替换的新稿要补清理。每张 sidecar 的 colorCleanup 给出前后 SHA 与 alpha SHA；所有已处理 alpha 字节相同。算法剩余的 10 个命中均位于雪花辉光粒子，非人物轮廓，应保留其透明度与颜色。
